general_rules.name: tutoiement_equipe
general_rules.description: Use tu form with direct team members (Lucas, team emails)
general_rules.trigger: Internal email to direct reports or team mailing lists
general_rules.action: Use casual greeting like 'Salut' or 'Hello', tu form, first name only

general_rules.name: vouvoiement_clients
general_rules.description: Always use vous form with external clients
general_rules.action: Use formal greeting, vous form, full signature with title and phone

general_rules.name: vouvoiement_hierarchie
general_rules.description: Use vous form with CEO and senior management
general_rules.trigger: Email to CEO or C-level executives
general_rules.action: Use formal 'Bonjour [First name]', vous form, professional closing

general_rules.name: vouvoiement_fournisseurs
general_rules.description: Use vous form with external vendors and suppliers
general_rules.action: Use 'Madame/Monsieur [Last name]' if first contact, vous form, full signature

general_rules.name: signature_externe
general_rules.description: Include full signature (name, title, company, phone) for external contacts
general_rules.trigger: First email or formal email to external contacts
general_rules.action:
End with 'Cordialement,
Sophie Martin
Chef de projet - Division Digitale
TechCorp | +33 6 12 34 56 78'

general_rules.name: signature_interne_peers
general_rules.description: Use first name only for internal peers and direct reports
general_rules.trigger: Email to internal techcorp.fr colleagues at same level

general_rules.name: anglais_internationaux
general_rules.description: Switch to English for international partners
general_rules.trigger: Email to contacts outside France (.com, .co.kr, .de domains)
general_rules.action: Use English, 'Hi [First name]' or 'Dear [First name]' depending on formality

general_rules.name: structure_listes
general_rules.description: Use numbered lists for action items and key points
general_rules.trigger: Email with multiple topics or action items
general_rules.action: Structure with numbered lists (1., 2., 3.) for clarity

general_rules.name: cc_technique
general_rules.description: CC technical lead Pierre on client technical discussions
general_rules.trigger: Email to clients discussing technical aspects or APIs
general_rules.action: Add 'Je me permets de joindre en copie Pierre Durand' and CC him

general_rules.name: questions_fin
general_rules.description: End with open question to prompt response
general_rules.trigger: Email requiring action or decision from recipient
general_rules.action: End with question like 'Ton avis ?' or 'Cette date vous convient-elle ?'
